reply_text:
I told Pree to send the truck to Bay 42 and posted that as a reply to her message in our DM.

On Oct 14 she told me in a DM that Bay 42 is her dock for Tansleigh Packaging pickups on the Quillon project from then on. I also pointed out that Dock 14 is the one she gave me for Tansley Parcel on the Larchmont project, since the two names get confused. Her message didn't say which project Thursday's pickup is for, so I asked her to tell me if it isn't Quillon.

She gave me both dock details privately, so I only used them in her own DM.
